依柏林國家圖書館藏手抄總譜（約1838，Canon a 3 Violini co: Transcribed note by note from the Violin I part on page 1 of the handwritten full score held by the Berlin State Library (c. 1838, Canon a 3 Violini con Basso), measures 3–18 (measures 1–2 are the ground bass alone, with Violin I resting, and are omitted); D major, 4/4, not transposed. The thirty-second-note variations that begin at measure 19 are not included; the ending is one added measure of our own, extending the first note of measure 19, A5, over a D chord to close. Chords follow the Cembalo ground bass D A B F# G D G A (one beat per note).
依 1739 年 Le Clerc 版 Violino Principale 分: Based on the Violino Principale part of the 1739 Le Clerc edition (Gallica btv1b9062998d), page 2, “La Primavera” Allegro: the pickup plus the opening ritornello in measures 1–13, and the B section bird song in measures 13–27 (up to before the Tutti enters); E major, 4/4, not transposed, no repeats omitted. The original has only the solo part; where the other violins answer in the bird song section, the soloist rests (the rests in measures 17, 18 and 19 are kept as in the original); chords are fitted to the melody as E / A / B triads (this page has no bass part to compare against). A 3.5-beat rest is added before the pickup E5 to make a full measure; ornaments (+, m.) are omitted; after the final half-note E6, a two-beat rest is added so that the excerpt ends before the Tutti.

依 C. A. Spina 1867 年首版鋼琴獨奏譜第 4 頁（Commons: Based on page 4 of C. A. The melody takes the highest voice of the right hand (the main melody alternating with octave-higher “echo” chords); in measures 28–29 the right hand is additionally doubled at the higher octave (F#6, D6), and to keep the melody continuous the lower main voice F#5, D5 is used instead; the chord in measure 32 takes only its top note; small slashed grace notes are omitted. Chords are inferred from the left-hand bass. The original marks only Tempo di Valse; the game uses ♩=132.
依 Breitkopf &amp; Härtel 1848 年總譜《仲夏夜之夢》: Based on the Breitkopf & Härtel 1848 full score of “A Midsummer Night’s Dream”, No. 9 Hochzeitmarsch (PDF pages 141–142, full score page numbers 137–138). The fanfare takes the top notes of the three trumpets (in C, written pitch is sounding pitch) in measures 1–5; the theme takes the top voice of the flute / Violin I in measures 6–13, repeated once, with the first ending (1ma Volta, measures 14–17, trumpet fanfare) in between; on beat 4 of measure 13 the first time adds the trumpet triplet pickup, the second time rests instead, closing on C. For the first note of measures 6 and 10, which also has chord tones doubled at the octave, only the top note is taken; trills and grace notes are omitted; the second ending after measure 13 of the second time is not used. Chords are inferred from the bass part (Violoncello/Basso); in the fanfare section the orchestra rests, and a C chord stands in for the accompaniment. The original tempo is Allegro vivace; the game uses ♩=96.

您在排行榜上選擇隱藏的玩家名單: The list of players you chose to hide on the leaderboard

設定暱稱之後，以下資料會存放在我們的伺服器上，直到您刪除為止：: After you set a nickname, the following data is stored on our server until you delete it:

<b>識別碼的雜湊值</b>：伺服器只保存您裝置上識別碼經過單向雜湊後的結果，無: Hash of the identifier: the server stores only the result of a one-way hash of the identifier on your device, from which the identifier itself cannot be recovered.
<b>排行榜成績</b>：每首曲目、每個難度您最好的一次成績（精準度、分數、最高: Leaderboard scores: your best result for each song and each difficulty (accuracy, score, max combo, time), plus the per-beat timing error record of that run and the device type (web, iOS or Android). <b>好友資料</b>：您的好友碼、好友名單、送出與收到的好友邀請、封鎖名單，以: Friend data: your friend code, friends list, friend requests sent and received, block list, and last online time.
<b>好友訊息</b>：您和好友之間的文字訊息，只有雙方看得到，保存 7 天後自: Friend messages: text messages between you and a friend, visible only to the two of you, and deleted automatically after 7 days. After you remove a friend or block the other person, neither of you can view these messages any more; the messages are still kept until the 7 days are up, and during that time are used only for handling reports. Messages are first filtered for inappropriate language, links and contact details.
<b>檢舉紀錄與審查</b>：您檢舉某則訊息或某位玩家時，伺服器會保存檢舉者、被: Reports and review: when you report a message or a player, the server stores the reporter, the reported player, and a copy of the reported message (or of the messages the other person most recently sent you). This content is handed to an AI model (Cloudflare Workers AI, which runs within Cloudflare, the Game’s server provider; this content is not provided to any other third party) to judge whether it violates the community guidelines; when a violation is confirmed, the message is deleted and the sender is suspended from sending messages for 1 day, 7 days or 30 days (depending on the number of violations). Reports that the AI cannot decide are reviewed manually by moderators. Report records are kept for up to 1 year; violation count records are deleted after the suspension ends and 180 days pass with no new violations.
<b>成就、外觀與遊玩統計</b>：您已達成的成就、擁有的外觀、目前使用的頭像、: Achievements, cosmetics and play statistics: the achievements you have earned, the cosmetics you own, the avatar, nameplate and title you currently use, and cumulative play statistics (for example, the number of clears, and the number of attempts and failures for each song and difficulty). Your avatar, nameplate and title are shown to other players.
<b>App 內購買</b>：在 iOS App 內購買完整版或外觀時，付款由: In-app purchases: when you buy the Full Version or cosmetics inside the iOS app, payment is handled by Apple, and we do not receive your name, payment method or Apple account. After a purchase, the app sends the transaction receipt issued by Apple to the server for verification, and the server stores the transaction ID, the item purchased, the purchase environment (production or test), the record time, and whether it has been refunded, linked to your nickname, in order to grant and restore the content you purchased. When you restore purchases under a different nickname, the purchased content moves to that nickname.
<b>上線狀態</b>：開著遊戲時，您的好友看得到您是否在線上、選曲中、遊戲中（: Online status: while the Game is open, your friends can see whether you are online, picking a song, playing (including the song title) or in a match. When you close the Game or switch it to the background, you show as offline. This status exists only in memory and is not written to the database.
未設定暱稱就不會上傳任何資料（您主動送出的問題回報除外，見下方），可以照常離線玩: If you have not set a nickname, no data is uploaded (except problem reports that you send yourself; see below), and you can still play single-player offline as usual.
<b>問題回報</b>：您在主畫面或暫停選單按「回報問題」並送出時，伺服器會保存: Problem reports: when you tap “Report a Problem” on the Home screen or the pause menu and submit, the server stores the problem type you chose, the description you wrote, the images you chose to attach (when you report from the pause menu, a screenshot of the current game screen is attached by default, and you can remove it before sending), and the device information listed in the report window: game version, web or app, browser and system version, screen size and pixel ratio, screen safe area and game frame width, language setting, the screen you were on when reporting (for example, Playing), latency offset value, the song and difficulty most recently played, and the most recent error message. If you have set a nickname, the report is linked to your nickname. Reports are used only by the developer to fix problems, are not made public, and are deleted automatically after 180 days. 三、使用線上對戰時處理的資料: 3. Data Handled When You Use Online Match
只有在您使用「線上對戰」或好友功能時，本遊戲才會連線到伺服器，並處理以下資料：: Only when you use “Online Match” or the friends features does the Game connect to the server and handle the following data:
<b>暱稱與對戰狀態</b>（分數、連擊、生命值、選擇的曲目與難度）：只傳給同一: Nickname and match state (score, combo, life, the song and difficulty chosen): sent only to the opponents in the same room. Not stored after the room closes or times out from inactivity.
<b>對戰邀請</b>：只傳給您邀請的好友，不保存。: Match invites: sent only to the friend you invite, and not stored.
<b>線上對戰結果</b>：登入帳號後進行線上對戰時，每局結束會把您送出的逐拍紀: Online match results: when you play an online match while signed in to an account, at the end of each round the per-beat record you submit is handed to the server to recalculate the score, and the result of that round is stored (song, difficulty, number of players, your place, score, accuracy, combo) along with the account codes of the opponents in the same room, in order to determine match and social achievements. The per-beat records are deleted as soon as the round is scored, and only the per-beat record of the 1st-place player of each round is kept in that round’s record, to check for cheating. A moderator may void a single round on suspicion of cheating. When you delete your account, your match results are deleted with it, and the per-beat records kept for the rounds in which you placed 1st are cleared as well; other players’ records are not affected.
<b>房間快速發言</b>：從固定的短語清單中選擇，只傳給同一房間的玩家，不保存: Quick Chat in rooms: chosen from a fixed list of short phrases, sent only to the players in the same room, and not stored.
<b>IP 位址</b>：只用來限制請求頻率，防止伺服器遭受攻擊；檢舉暱稱與送出: IP address: used only to limit request rates and protect the server from attacks; when a nickname is reported or a problem report is submitted, a hash of the IP address is stored to prevent repeated reports from the same network and to limit the number of reports per day. It is not used to identify individuals and is not combined with other data.
